title: <slot-view>: portable widgets
blurb: A piece of another site laid out in a line of your text, without an iframe's box. The other site asks the reader before it sends any pixels, and it confirms "Buy now" itself.
question: Can an element from another origin be laid out inline at its own size, with a permission prompt on the providing origin?

waitsForPerson.why: its checks stop at the consent prompt until someone presses Allow, which is the point of the demo

cls.why: known: a paragraph moves about a second in, when the widget's first picture arrives and sets its size
